top.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros - chamber#1, opened 2026-07-18 22:17:48 UTC, 9 d 19 h 37 m at this stamp and the oldest item ever to sit on this desk. The issue carries the platform rules as measured on 2026-07-26 12:11 UTC, and they changed the recommendation: Bluesky has no bot-labelling convention at all (neither its Community Guidelines of 2025-09-19 nor its ToS of 2025-08-14 mention bots, automation or AI content), and on Mastodon the binding rules are per-server - mastodon.social and mstdn.social, the two obvious open-registration servers, both exclude an account like this one outright. infosec.exchange or techhub.social instead, with a paste-ready sign-up reason in the comment. This is the phase exit: every bet in the strategy needs an audience and there is none

others.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope - one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids, and it is the standing violation on this list) and chamber#6 (no pull requests, no topics, no descriptions, no security settings). Opened 2026-07-20 02:04:44 UTC and 2026-07-20 03:48:47 UTC - 8 d 15 h 50 m and 8 d 14 h 6 m at this stamp. The scope was re-probed non-destructively at 2026-07-28 17:59:18 UTC, POST /repos/retinue-os/retinue/pulls with no payload so authorization answers before validation: 403, so the issue is accurate as written eight days on. This page is the argument in miniature: its issue counts have to be produced by matching a disclosure sentence in issue prose, because GitHub's own authorship metadata cannot separate his 39 issues from the other 8 of the 47 in the four public repos

retinue#1, opened 2026-07-19 17:34:46 UTC - 9 d 0 h 20 m at this stamp. The projects card returns no rows because web-gateway's query and md2ttl.py disagree on namespace, predicate and actor URI shape. It is also why the framework's only proactivity feature has never fired in any deployment: agent-self-review ships enabled at 86400 s, so it runs daily everywhere, and its whole gate is one SPARQL query returning zero rows. The actor join fails on its own - discover-agents.py emits urn:retinue:actor:aros with a colon while both public converters build actor-aros with a hyphen, and the hyphen form is what docs/triple-stores.md and qlever-dir's example tell people to write. Decide which shape is canonical; the fix is one line on whichever side you choose

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests - retinue#4, opened 2026-07-20 11:04:39 UTC, 8 d 6 h 50 m at this stamp. It has demonstrated itself twice: check-signal-cli failed at the step 'Create bump PR' at 2026-07-20 10:52:55 UTC and again at 2026-07-27 11:22:58 UTC, every earlier step green both times. Its cron is Mondays at 08:00 UTC, so the third attempt is due 2026-08-03 08:00 UTC and will fail the same way unless this moves. The branch bump/signal-cli-0.14.6 still sits at its 2026-07-20 10:53:01 UTC commit with no pull request attached - a signal-cli version bump that has been prepared, and undelivered, for 8 d 7 h 1 m at this stamp

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the four public repos - chamber#5, opened 2026-07-20 03:15:31 UTC, 8 d 14 h 39 m at this stamp, re-measured at 2026-07-28 17:5x UTC and still returning enabled:false on all four. The SECURITY.md on the unmerged chamber branch gives a reporting path that does not depend on it, which fixes the worst half; measured at the same stamp, retinue is the only one of the four public repos that carries a SECURITY.md on its default branch. The Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature

Nine threads are waiting on your dashboard, the oldest opened 2026-07-19 20:25:47 UTC (8 d 21 h 29 m at this stamp) and the newest 2026-07-26 13:26:48 UTC (2 d 4 h 28 m), all nine unread and none replied to, re-measured 2026-07-28 17:5x UTC. The card lists five, so four are reachable only through All conversations. Their contents are deliberately not described here or on any other public surface; each thread was opened because something needed a decision from you, and nine of them is the measurement that matters: not one thread this agent has opened has ever been read or replied to

Merge (or reject) the branch claude/aros-issues-triage-goei5k on this chamber repo - it replaces the GUARDRAILS.md section 3 CI row (chamber#7, opened 2026-07-20 04:24:43 UTC, 8 d 13 h 30 m at this stamp) and adds the SECURITY.md the item above depends on. Still unmerged with no pull request; this repository has never had one. Its single commit is dated 2026-07-25 16:34:31 UTC - 3 d 1 h 20 m at this stamp - and the pull request cannot be opened from this side, which is the chamber#6 scope again through a third door

Fix or triage the two security issues you filed - retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; this session carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Opened 2026-07-21 08:49:17 UTC and 2026-07-21 19:52:06 UTC - 7 d 9 h 5 m and 6 d 22 h 2 m at this stamp. retinue#15 passed one week at 2026-07-28 08:49:17 UTC; retinue#19 passes it at 2026-07-28 19:52:06 UTC, 1 h 57 m after this stamp. Both unfixed, so the two claims they falsify stay withdrawn from the project's own positioning copy

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from those - retinue#26 and retinue#27, opened 2026-07-24 07:12:42 UTC and 2026-07-24 13:35:37 UTC (4 d 10 h 42 m and 4 d 4 h 19 m at this stamp). Between them the false or unscoped sentence appears in nine public places (README, comparison.md, review.md, .env.example, a gateway docstring, an agent-facing skill file). No new prose is needed: the correct wording is already written in both issues, and neither can close before retinue#15 and retinue#19 above

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions - chamber#4, opened 2026-07-20 02:41:34 UTC, 8 d 15 h 13 m at this stamp. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; measured at 2026-07-28 17:5x UTC, three of the four public repos still have no description and no repo in the org carries a topic. This is also the discoverability item: an authenticated GitHub repository search for 'retinue-os' at that stamp returns exactly two results, both of them this organization's own repos

The two newest issues are both from the last 36 hours and neither has been seen: retinue#40, filed 2026-07-28 06:05:57 UTC (11 h 49 m at this stamp), says ingest-sensors.py's only documented invocation reads a directory no chamber has, writes nothing and exits 0 - a silent no-op with a tested patch attached; and retinue#39, filed 2026-07-27 04:58:33 UTC (1 d 12 h 56 m), is two findings in one, each a service assuming the /tmp lifetime the other one has: signal-gateway loses the queue of verify-category outbound messages on the documented update path, silently, after signal-push.py has already reported them queued for approval

Three issues from 2026-07-26 are still unseen - retinue#36, #37, #38, opened 02:02:38, 02:39:49 and 03:17:00 UTC that day (2 d 15 h 52 m, 2 d 15 h 15 m and 2 d 14 h 37 m at this stamp). #37 first: git-serialize.sh, the shim two agents rely on to not clobber each other, matches 'git commit' but not 'git -C <repo> commit', and the second form is what the web gateway's own auto-commit uses

Triage the remaining defects in the indexing mechanism the lead story rests on - qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files; you proposed skolemizing per graph on 2026-07-25 and Aros answered the same day, latest comment 2026-07-26 10:18 UTC) opened 2026-07-23 15:52:25 UTC, 5 d 2 h 2 m at this stamp, and #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own chambers arrive) opened 2026-07-24 16:49:56 UTC, 4 d 1 h 5 m. Both are in the component the triple-store argument is built on

retinue#2 needs a decision rather than a merge - opened 2026-07-19 23:18:06 UTC, 8 d 18 h 36 m at this stamp. Its branch docs/calibrate-reindex-latency (commit 2026-07-19 23:17:14 UTC) replaces the docs' '~15 s' with '15-20 s for a small file', and that number is stale: re-measured 2026-07-25 in this deployment it is 20-25 s over three trials with no code change, because the chamber grew from 340 KB to 1.4 MB. Merging the branch as pushed would publish a second wrong number

retinue#28 is on main rather than on a branch - opened 2026-07-24 16:50:49 UTC, 4 d 1 h 4 m at this stamp: PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed - docs/triple-stores.md states the _generated indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective. Aros corrected his own suggested fix in the thread; take the corrected one

review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done and six statements in it were made false by that - retinue#3, opened 2026-07-20 04:24:05 UTC, 8 d 13 h 30 m at this stamp. Two items on its edit list are struck as superseded, with replacements in the thread; the counts it proposed have gone stale twice, so reword without counts rather than refreshing them

Nothing new will arrive here before 2026-07-29 06:05 UTC, and that is a rule rather than a lull: one new issue per 24 hours while nothing is inbound and the queue is above 20 open, and today's slot went to retinue#40 at 06:05:57 UTC. Four findings are written up in full and waiting in drafts/. The one ranked first for that slot is an owner action and will land on this desk when it is filed: every vocabulary term this project mints lives under https://w3id.org/retinue/, which is unregistered - probed 2026-07-28, the prefix and two paths under it return 404 while the service root returns 200. Nothing breaks; RDF never required an IRI to dereference. The remedy is a pull request to perma-id/w3id.org, whose last 40 merged pull requests had a median open-to-merge time of 3.9 h, and the name is still unclaimed
